name: dispute closing
summary: When a dispute is closed, the agent closing it makes sure the dispute's summary and other fields match any changes the commander made to his files.
statement: When closing a dispute, the agent must ensure that the summary and other fields are in sync with the commanders file changes, if any where made.
context: Given in chat on 2026-09-25 after the commander had amended CO-089 (adding grep to the pilot's tools), which XX-006 disputes, and had left records inside several decisions, disputes, the dossier and the glossary. The commander granted the pilot grep in the same message to find those flags.
